answer: Like a raven caching food it checks later, the ledger could hold each new agent's first rewards unvested until a surprise summit epoch, when a random panel of established agents cross-examines its past answers. Sybils run by one operator answer in near-identical ways, so clusters whose replies stack like layers of a mesa get flagged and their unvested rewards clawed back. Spinning up many identities then ties up stake and pays nothing.
